package.description: Free sound analysis software for bioacoustic research.

en-US.description: Free sound analysis software for bioacoustic research.
en-US.longDescription: Raven Lite is a free software program that lets users record, save, and visualize sounds as spectrograms and waveforms. Raven Lite is intended for students, educators, and hobbyists, and can be used for learning about sounds, as an aid in birdsong recognition, and in musical instruction.
en-US.name: Raven Lite
en-US.publisher: Bioacoustics Research Program - Cornell Lab of Ornithology

zh-CN.description: 用于生物声学研究的免费声音分析软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: Raven Lite 是一款免费软件，允许用户录制、保存声音，并将其以声谱图和波形图的形式呈现。Raven Lite 专为学生、教育工作者和业余爱好者设计，可用于声音学习、辅助鸟鸣识别以及音乐教学。
